items.title: Lambda SnapStart Comes to Container Images, Ending a Packaging Tradeoff
items.blurb: AWS has extended Lambda SnapStart to container image functions, which hold up to 10 GB against 250 MB for zip archives. Teams previously chose between dependency headroom and sub-second startup.

items.title: AWS Lambda now supports direct read configuration for Amazon S3 Files
items.blurb: AWS Lambda now supports direct read configuration for Amazon S3 Files, letting you configure which storage your functions read from: S3 Files high-performance storage or your S3 bucket.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports model caching for faster inference autoscaling and reduced cold starts
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports model caching, an inference optimization that pre-loads model weights and container images onto cluster nodes so pods start in seconds instead of minutes.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports multimodal embeddings for video, audio, and image content with TwelveLabs Marengo 3.0
items.blurb: AWS announces the availability of TwelveLabs Marengo 3.0 as an embedding model in Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, enabling customers to create multimodal embeddings for video, audio, and image content.

items.title: Amazon EC2 X2idn instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong)
items.blurb: Memory-optimized Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X2idn instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong) Region.

items.title: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch
items.blurb: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, giving you visibility into workflow resource utilization as runs execute.

items.title: AWS DevOps Agent adds support for bidirectional Slack communication
items.blurb: AWS DevOps Agent now enables engineers to manage production operations across AWS, multicloud, and on-premises environments with the complete investigation lifecycle directly within Slack.
